events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.location: Unique Lancaster, 23 N Walnut Street, Lancaster, 17603

events.title: Candlelight Open House
events.description: Experience Historic Ephrata Cloister in a whole new light – by candlelight! As the sun sets on Saturday, November 14th, the site’s pathways and buildings glow with the light of candles, creating an unforgettable evening atmosphere throughout the grounds from 5:00pm-8:00pm. This self-guided event allows you to explore the illuminated grounds at your own pace. Step inside the historic buildings to encounter interpreters, skilled craftspeople, and historical demonstrators who will share the stories, trades, and traditions of Ephrata’s past. Throughout the night, enjoy: Family-friendly activities and happenings perfect for all ages. Vendors and craftspeople displaying their unique, handmade wares! Performances by the Ephrata Cloister Chorus at 5:30pm and 6:30pm in the historic 1741 Meetinghouse. Seating is limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis; wristbands are required for entry and are free with admission. Fireside tales and tellings at the bonfire as well as sweet treats available by donation! Costumed interpreters in the cemetery to learn about Ephrata’s historic burial grounds. Night Hikes by the Creek to the Witness Tree at 5:15pm, 6:15pm, and 7:15pm, hikes start at the Physician’s House! Groups are limited; spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis. Food and drink will be available for purchase, including delicious local donuts and hot beverages from WDonuts’ Dub Truck! Don’t miss this chance to experience the site’s rich history brought to life after dark.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.description: Join us at Strasburg Rail Road for a cozy evening tradition that has been around for almost 15 years and is certain to become a yearly ritual for your family as well! Our Night Before Christmas trains will put you in the holiday spirit as our talented cast recites the classic poem by Clement Clarke Moore as well as other festive Christmas stories. What to expect upon arrival: Be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes early, as the train will begin boarding 15 minutes before departure. You can check in at our station box office between platforms 3 & 4. All aboard!

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Reed Timmer at American Music Theatre
events.description: Dominate the Storm: A Heart Pumping Evening with Reed Timmer, America’s Most Famous Storm Chaser Never Stop Chasing! Experience the raw power of nature through the eyes of Dr. Reed Timmer, extreme meteorologist, scientist, and one of the world’s most renowned storm chasers. With a PhD in meteorology from the University of Oklahoma, Reed has devoted his life to intercepting the planet’s most dangerous storms, collecting groundbreaking scientific data, and helping audiences better understand how severe weather is changing. Over the past several decades, Reed has intercepted more than 1,000 tornadoes and 50 hurricanes, including EF5 tornadoes and Category 5 hurricanes. He is also the inventor of the Dominators – armored, tank-like storm-chasing vehicles equipped with advanced meteorological sensors, hydraulic anchoring spikes, drones, probes, balloons, and even model rockets. Since 2020, Reed has driven Dominator 3 directly into 10 tornadoes, more than any other person in history. His unforgettable expeditions include recording 140 mph winds from inside a Nebraska tornado and launching a trackable sensor into a mile-wide EF4 tornado in Kansas. Carried as high as 39,000 feet and reaching speeds of 190 mph, the sensor captured unprecedented data throughout its 30-mile journey inside the vortex. Currently chasing storms for the National Geographic Channel and RadarOmega, Reed also provides vital real-time reports through traditional and social media. Hear the incredible stories, witness breathtaking footage, and discover the science behind Earth’s most powerful storms during this heart-pumping live event. For Reed Timmer, “Never Stop Chasing” is more than a motto – it is a way of life. events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.
events.categories: Children & Family Events, Food & Beverage Events, Lancaster City, Tour
events.location: Unique Lancaster, 23 N Walnut Street, Lancaster, 17603

Children under 6 years old are free with an adult ticket

Children under 6 years old are free with an adult ticket

Children under 6 years old are free with an adult ticket

events.title: Night Before Christmas at Strasburg Rail Road
events.description: Join us at Strasburg Rail Road for a cozy evening tradition that has been around for almost 15 years and is certain to become a yearly ritual for your family as well! Our Night Before Christmas trains will put you in the holiday spirit as our talented cast recites the classic poem by Clement Clarke Moore as well as other festive Christmas stories. Your family will also be regaled by a troupe of carolers singing and dancing to a medley of your favorite Christmas carols. But the night would not be complete without the timeless combination of milk and cookies and perhaps even a glimpse of Santa Claus himself hurriedly preparing for his most important night of the year! You definitely don’t want to miss out on experiencing this special holiday train ride, so book your tickets now! What to expect upon arrival: Be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes early, as the train will begin boarding 15 minutes before departure. You can check in at our station box office between platforms 3 & 4. All aboard!

Our Night Before Christmas trains will put you in the holiday spirit as our talented cast recites the classic poem by Clement Clarke Moore as well as other festive Christmas stories. Your family will also be regaled by a troupe of carolers singing and dancing to a medley of your favorite Christmas carols. But the night would not be complete without the timeless combination of milk and cookies and perhaps even a glimpse of Santa Claus himself hurriedly preparing for his most important night of the year! You definitely don’t want to miss out on experiencing this special holiday train ride, so book your tickets now! What to expect upon arrival: Be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes early, as the train will begin boarding 15 minutes before departure. You can check in at our station box office between platforms 3 & 4. All aboard!

Our Night Before Christmas trains will put you in the holiday spirit as our talented cast recites the classic poem by Clement Clarke Moore as well as other festive Christmas stories. Your family will also be regaled by a troupe of carolers singing and dancing to a medley of your favorite Christmas carols. But the night would not be complete without the timeless combination of milk and cookies and perhaps even a glimpse of Santa Claus himself hurriedly preparing for his most important night of the year! You definitely don’t want to miss out on experiencing this special holiday train ride, so book your tickets now! What to expect upon arrival: Be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes early, as the train will begin boarding 15 minutes before departure. You can check in at our station box office between platforms 3 & 4. All aboard!

Our Night Before Christmas trains will put you in the holiday spirit as our talented cast recites the classic poem by Clement Clarke Moore as well as other festive Christmas stories. Your family will also be regaled by a troupe of carolers singing and dancing to a medley of your favorite Christmas carols. But the night would not be complete without the timeless combination of milk and cookies and perhaps even a glimpse of Santa Claus himself hurriedly preparing for his most important night of the year! You definitely don’t want to miss out on experiencing this special holiday train ride, so book your tickets now! What to expect upon arrival: Be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes early, as the train will begin boarding 15 minutes before departure. You can check in at our station box office between platforms 3 & 4. All aboard!

events.title: Little Explorer and Me at North Museum
events.description: Sign up for an exciting, hands-on program where curiosity and learning come to life as Little Explorers and their grown ups experiment and discover together. Where curiosity and learning come to life as Little Explorers and their grown ups experiment and discover together. Every month, a trained facilitator guides you through a new theme that sparks your child’s imagination while helping build critical skills through fun and interactive play. Each activity is designed to be easy for you to recreate at home with everyday materials, giving your child the chance to explore and engage with the world around them. Whether it’s learning about the wonders of sound, exploring the colors of the rainbow, or discovering the magic of play, your child will gain valuable knowledge they can use in everyday life. PRE-REGISTER—We kindly ask that all register in advance of attending this program so our facilitator can prepare materials. Registrations do not grant access to the museum. All non-members must purchase a general admission ticket ($13 each) online or at the door. BUY TICKETS–GENERAL ADMISSION Members enter FREE. Wednesdays at 10:00 am & 3:00 pm COME FOR LITTLE EXPLORER AND ME, STAY FOR THE PLANETARIUM SHOW 11am—One World, One Sky, Big Bird’s Adventure.

events.title: Root’s Old Mill Flea Market
events.description: Come to Root’s Old Mill Flea Market and experience the thrill of discovering hidden treasures around every corner! From vintage artwork and antique lamps to heirloom furniture and one-of-a-kind collectibles, you never know what you’ll find waiting for you at Root’s. Bring the whole family and enjoy browsing 175+ vendor stands offering a variety of antiques, collectibles, estate jewelry, household treasures, tools, decor, and so much more—indoors and outdoors. Interested in becoming a Flea Market vendor? Reservations are required for Tuesday market. Requests may be placed by calling (717) 898-7443 beginning at the end of market day (3pm on Tuesday) through Monday at 12 noon. Vendor spaces on Tuesday start at $20. Saturday Flea Market spaces are first come, first served. Only $10! Vendors who participate on Saturdays receive priority placement for Tuesdays. *Please mention if you’re bringing a trailer or large vehicle, so that we may better accommodate you. Be sure to check our calendar of events to confirm Root’s Saturday Flea Market dates and times. Additional Shopping & Fun Things To Do in Lancaster?
